title: Sensitivity and block sensitivity
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: OpenAI's superquadratic separation (2026): for every constant C there is a Boolean function with block sensitivity larger than C times the square of its sensitivity, and composition gives a fixed power larger than 2. The first lesson defines the two measures, proves the lemmas on disjoint ORs and on composition, gives Rubinstein's quadratic example and the powering argument. The second builds nested predicates from Hamming balls and from clauses on a labelled tournament, with random labels, and proves the block count at zero and the bounds at level zero. The third proves the four sensitivity recurrences, bounds the growth of the profiles, and proves the theorem and the power separation.
prerequisites: core course Probability (finite probability: independence and the union bound)
